reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent; fresh Radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 recovery of retail igi.exe, plus the previously captured Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP artifact for the unchanged retail image. The live Binary Ninja MCP endpoint (127.0.0.1:24642) was unavailable in this round (connection refused).
scope: Symbol disambiguation and source-semantic review of retail Debug_Error (0x004AF7B0), including the display/exit callbacks, the genuine null-callback return and the installed non-returning exit path. No paired retail/candidate game-process runtime capture exists; behaviour is not claimed as RUNTIME_TESTED or VERIFIED.

decompiler.prototype_note: Binary Ninja reports a non-variadic one-argument prototype. The 274 retail call sites clean 4, 8 or more stack bytes after the call, and the body builds a va_list pointer to [esp+8] at 0x004AF7CD-0x004AF7D1, so cdecl variadic is the ABI the call sites and the body prove.

abi.stack_cleanup: caller; 274 call sites, e.g. 0x00415B6A add esp,8 after 0x00415B65, 0x00415F8D add esp,4 after 0x00415F88

callback_paths.installer: 0x00498900: push 0x00498930; call 0x004AF8A0 (sets exit 0x0093626C); push 0x004988D0; call 0x004AF860 (sets display 0x00936268); also sets 0x00936274 and 0x0093625C. 0x00498950 first calls 0x004AF8C0 to zero all six hooks, then jumps to 0x00498900; 0x00532400 calls 0x00498950 at 0x00532405.
callback_paths.display_callback_0x004988D0: ShowCursor(1); MessageBoxA(g_5c8bc4, buffer, g_5c8bd4, MB_ICONHAND=0x10); ShowCursor(0); returns.
callback_paths.exit_callback_0x00498930: call 0x0048F1B0; if EAX != 0 DebugBreak(); push 1; call 0x004A5AD5 (CRT exit); the following bytes are NOP padding, so the installed path does not return. 0x004A5AD5 -> 0x004A5AF7, which calls TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess(), code) when shutdown has begun or ExitProcess(code) otherwise.
callback_paths.non_returning_case: Only after 0x00498930 is installed. Debug_Error itself still has a genuine return: null exit callback -> EAX=0 at 0x004AF808. The examined fatal callers append `jmp $`, so the call sequence is terminal either way.

branch_semantics: 0x004AF7B0: mov eax,[0x00936268]; test eax,eax; je 0x004AF7FD - the whole report block is skipped when the display callback is null.

0x004AF7B9-0x004AF7FC: sprintf(buffer, "Fatal error:\n\n"); repne scasb scans buffer for its NUL; String_VFormat(buffer + (~i - 1), format, va_list([esp+0x14])); call [0x00936268] with buffer; add esp,0x18; pop edi.
0x004AF7FD: mov eax,[0x0093626C]; test eax,eax; je 0x004AF808 - return 0 when null; otherwise jmp eax.

call_sequence: strlen(buffer) - GCC lowering of the NUL scan
call dword [display callback] with buffer (when non-null)
read exit callback; if null xor eax,eax and ret; otherwise call eax and return its result
candidate_structure.disassembly_summary: 0x0041FC10 sub esp,0x14; mov [esp+0xC],ebx; call Error_GetGlobals; mov ebx,eax; mov eax,[eax]; test eax,eax; je 0x0041FC71; lea esi,[ebx+8]; mov [esp],esi; call __mingw_sprintf; cmp byte [ebx+8],0; je 0x0041FC88; lea eax,[ebx+9]; call strlen; lea edx,[esi+eax+1]; lea eax,[esp+0x1C] (va_list); call String_VFormat; mov [esp],esi; call [ebx]; ... 0x0041FC71 mov eax,[ebx+4]; test eax,eax; je 0x0041FC90; call eax; ... ret; 0x0041FC90 xor eax,eax; ret
codegen_divergences: Retail scans the prefix with inline repne scasb; GCC lowers the same loop to a strlen call. The resulting append offset is identical for the NUL-terminated prefix.

Retail tail-dispatches the exit callback with jmp eax; the candidate emits call eax followed by a normal epilogue, which still returns the callback result. The call targets and state effects are identical.
Retail addresses 0x00936268/0x0093626C/0x00A84640 absolutely; the candidate reads the same three fields from port-owned ErrorGlobalsState via Error_GetGlobals().
The candidate installs neither callback; retail installs them at 0x00498900. Until that installer is ported the candidate takes the null-callback path and returns 0 silently.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail 0x004AF7B0 is the 89-byte Debug_Error dispatcher: 5 blocks/5 edges, 274 call sites, variadic cdecl. The candidate defines exactly one Debug_Error (0x0041FC10) and no Error_Show.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: Retail: [esp+4] format, va_list pointer built from [esp+8] and passed to String_VFormat; candidate: same C cdecl variadic signature, lea eax,[esp+0x1C] after its own frame points at the first substitution. The 274 call sites clean 4/8/0xC stack bytes.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: The only embedded data are the prefix "Fatal error:\n\n" at 0x00546DB8 and the three field offsets 0/4/8 in the globals block; the candidate writes the same 14-byte prefix and uses the same field roles. No scaling arithmetic exists.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: Retail reads 0x00936268/0x0093626C and appends into 0x00A84640 at the first NUL. The candidate reads the same three fields through ErrorGlobalsState (g_936268, g_93626c, g_a84640[0x1000]) and appends at buffer + strlen. Size and access order match; absolute addresses are not reproduced.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Call order matches: sprintf(prefix), NUL scan, String_VFormat(append), display callback(buffer), then exit callback. Retail uses repne scasb and jmp eax; GCC uses strlen and call/return. Those are reviewed codegen-equivalent differences. The callback installers remain unported and are recorded as a limitation.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Null exit callback -> EAX=0 at 0x004AF808; candidate xor eax,eax/ret. Non-null -> retail jmp eax forwards the callback result; candidate call eax/return forwards the same value. The installed 0x00498930 callback exits the process and never returns; examined fatal callers append jmp $.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The function formats and dispatches text; it performs no floating-point arithmetic. The differential covers literal and signed-integer formats only.

checks.name: caller_routing
checks.detail: Twelve former error::Error_Show call sites now call Debug_Error, the retail symbol; callers that already used Debug_Error are unchanged.

checks.name: behavioural_differential
checks.detail: error_show_diff_runner.py: retail VEX execution versus the compiled candidate for 16 cases (flags 0/1/2/3, literal and signed formats), comparing return, 0x1000 buffer, display/exit side effects. Emulator/host evidence only.

checks.name: build
checks.detail: Compiles for i686-w64-mingw32 -O3 -DNDEBUG and links one Debug_Error at 0x0041FC10.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports int32_t(char* arg1). The body and the 274 call sites prove x86 cdecl variadic int32_t(const char* format, ...). The candidate matches the proven ABI; the decompiler prototype is a simplification.

removed_symbols.name: igi::retail::error::Error_Show(char const*, ...)
removed_symbols.classification: port scaffolding, not a retail function
removed_symbols.reason: It reproduced the same retail VA 0x004AF7B0 body under a second name, creating two candidate answers for one address.

disambiguation.note: Error_Show is not a second retail function: the same 89-byte body at 0x004AF7B0 is the only implementation. Removing the duplicate and routing callers to Debug_Error leaves one candidate symbol per retail address and matches the catalog name.

limitations: No paired retail/candidate game-process runtime capture exists for this address. RUNTIME_TESTED and VERIFIED are not claimed.

The candidate installs neither callback global. Retail installs them at 0x00498900 (display 0x004988D0 MessageBoxA/MB_ICONHAND, exit 0x00498930 DebugBreak+exit(1)); those bodies remain unported, so the candidate currently takes the silent null-callback return.
Retail tail-dispatches with jmp eax; the candidate emits call/return. This preserves the callback result but is not instruction-identical.
Retail uses repne scasb; GCC emits strlen. The append offset is identical for a NUL-terminated prefix.
The candidate uses port-owned storage through Error_GetGlobals() instead of the absolute retail addresses.
The behavioural differential is emulator/host execution, not a live paired retail/candidate game process, and models formatters and callbacks explicitly.
The live Binary Ninja MCP endpoint was unavailable this round; the retail Binary Ninja artifact is a previously captured, byte-bound record for the unchanged retail image.
